name: accept
message: Here's a 4.2 km bike route, about 18 minutes, with 38 m of climbing. It stops at Canadian Tire on Yonge, avoids highways, and 72% of it is on bike lanes or paths. I couldn't check for closures, so watch for signs on the way.

name: accept_two_warnings
message: Here's a 4.2 km bike route, about 18 minutes, with 38 m of climbing. It stops at Canadian Tire on Yonge. I couldn't check for closures, and I couldn't confirm the opening hours. There is a cafe 180 m from the route if you need one (Sponsored: Dark Horse Espresso).
